verdict.rationale: Trello's own site says it can "Automate tasks and workflows," so the product claims a first-party automation capability. Nothing in the pack describes how it works: no rule builder, triggers or actions, multi-step chaining, or no-code authoring. Power-Up buttons and the developer platform are code-based building blocks and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: documented no-code rule/trigger builder, evidence of multi-step action chaining, PM-facing setup docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can build multi-step automations without writing code

citations.quote: Automate tasks and workflows with Trello.
